verses.english: Ten Discourses On How Giving Helps Rebirth in Fragrant Roots

verses.pali: Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Seated to one side, that mendicant said to the Buddha:

verses.pali: “ko nu kho, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yena midhekacco kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā mūlagandhe adhivatthānaṁ devānaṁ sahabyataṁ upapajjatī”ti?
verses.english: “Sir, what is the cause, what is the reason why someone, when their body breaks up, after death, is reborn in the company of the gods who live in fragrant roots?”

verses.pali: “Idha, bhikkhu, ekacco kāyena sucaritaṁ carati, vācāya sucaritaṁ carati, manasā sucaritaṁ carati.
verses.english: “Mendicant, it’s when someone does good things by way of body, speech, and mind.
‘The gods who live in fragrant roots are long-lived, beautiful, and very happy.’

verses.pali: ‘aho vatāhaṁ kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā mūlagandhe adhivatthānaṁ devānaṁ sahabyataṁ upapajjeyyan’ti.
verses.english: ‘If only, when my body breaks up, after death, I would be reborn in the company of the gods who live in fragrant roots!’

verses.pali: So kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā mūlagandhe adhivatthānaṁ devānaṁ sahabyataṁ upapajjati.
verses.english: When their body breaks up, after death, they’re reborn in the company of the gods who live in fragrant roots.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ kho, bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṁ paccayo, yena midhekacco kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā mūlagandhe adhivatthānaṁ devānaṁ sahabyataṁ upapajjatī”ti.
verses.english: This is the cause, this is the reason why someone, when their body breaks up, after death, is reborn in the company of the gods who live in fragrant roots.”
